title: A confirmed signup is scored at submission
description:
**Phase 2 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the survey submission and confirmation stories
- **Runs in parallel with:** the disqualification story
- **Unblocks:** the operator queue story

---
Deterministic, computed once when the signup is confirmed, stored on the record. Not computed at read time — the queue has to be sortable and the score has to be explainable months later against the weights that were in force when it was assigned.

Store the weights version alongside the score. These weights get recalibrated after fifty responses, and a queue holding scores from two different scoring schemes with no way to tell them apart is worse than no score.

The full table is on the epic.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Waitlist triage

  Scenario: A senior AWS buyer with budget scores highly
    Given a confirmed waitlist signup
    And they run production workloads on AWS
    And their organization has 101 or more people
    And they answered yes with budget to professional services
    And they can approve AWS access themselves
    When the signup is scored
    Then its score is at least 10
    And it is marked services-qualified

  Scenario: A curious individual scores low
    Given a confirmed waitlist signup
    And their organization has 1 to 5 people
    And they answered not now to professional services
    And they are just exploring
    When the signup is scored
    Then it is not marked services-qualified

  Scenario: A score records the weights it was computed with
    Given a confirmed waitlist signup
    When the signup is scored
    Then the record carries the scoring weights version
